methodology_notes: Quantities are measured from the sketch, interior wall to wall. Baseboard, shoe molding and tack strip follow the perimeter less doorways and cabinet runs. New floor includes waste for cuts (more for diagonal and herringbone); carpet that takes most of a 12' roll is priced by the cut it needs. Material tax of 6% is in the unit prices. Prices typed in on the estimate are used as entered.
